vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Acme WebGateway Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Acme WebGateway contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the authentication module that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain system-level access.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GlobalTech FileManager Pro Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: GlobalTech FileManager Pro contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read or write files outside the intended directory.
